description: Ready-made workflows: provision volumes to an FC, iSCSI or NVMe/TCP host, create or grow a pool, create a mainframe (3390) pool, extend or delete volumes, create a command device, reclaim zero pages, read-only inventory, copy groups. With no arguments lists them. With `recipe`, shows its parameters and steps. With `query`, ranks recipes by keyword. Use raidcom_build_recipe to turn one into a script.

query.description: Words describing the task, e.g. "new ESXi host".

recipe.description: Recipe ID to show in detail, e.g. provision-fc-volumes.

name: raidcom_list_recipes
title: List raidcom recipes
